name: Should I do a foreclosed bathroom refresh myself or hire a contractor?
description: DIY can work for paint, hardware, and minor cosmetic updates. Hire a pro if there is water damage, old plumbing, mold concerns, or any need to move fixtures.

mainEntity.name: Should I do a foreclosed bathroom refresh myself or hire a contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a foreclosed property, a professional is usually worth it when you suspect **hidden water damage**, see signs of mold, or need repairs that touch plumbing or electrical systems. A contractor can also help you sequence the work so you do not install finishes over an unresolved problem.
